text:
lina: Heads-up — client NovaGrid onboarding shows p95 spike after a model bump: p95=2.4s (was ~1.0s). Mostly short chats + occasional long contexts. Proactive plan: 5% canary to compact-int4, enable prefix cache on short-route, reduce max_batch_wait_ms. Need SE + SRE OK.

mike: Dashboard? token distro?

lina: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/novagrid/latency 
Summary: 70% <80 tokens, 25% 80-512, 5% >512. Concurrency up from new webhook. No error spike.

ryan: Agreed. Steps: 1) canary 5% -> redwood-compact-13b-int4, 2) prefix KV cache on short route TTL=30s, 3) set max_batch_wait_ms=6 for short route, 4) fallback if p95 regresses.

parth: Risks: semantic drift (low) — mitigate with 10-prompt eval set; stale cache with dynamic system prompts (med) — mitigate with short TTL + mismatch alerts; throughput drop (med) — mitigate with autoscale burst.

lina: I will run canary and notify customer. SEs please draft route override and eval set.

mike: Draft override: route=/v1/chat/completions, canary=5%, model=redwood-compact-13b-int4, batching.max_batch_wait_ms=6, cache.prefix=true, cache.ttl_ms=30000. Also ask client to add tiny client retry.

ryan: Ill add autoscale guard and fallback rule: revert after 3 consecutive p95 breaches. Deploy-bot, schedule 20m canary at 14:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled start=5050505400 (14:30 UTC) duration=20m route=/v1/chat/completions percent=5 owner=lina 

lina: Notifying NovaGrid: "Running 20m canary at 14:30 UTC to test compact model + caching; no downtime expected; will share results and revert if needed." Will attach eval prompts. :thumbsup: 

mike: Ill monitor p50/p95, queue lengths, eval metrics. Post here if we need to abort.

ryan: Enable tracing on top-3 endpoints during canary to correlate KV hits.

lina: Tracing enabled. Will post results within 30m of canary end: p50/p95, KV hit rate, eval deltas. Thanks team
